content: GOPC, also known as Golgi-associated PDZ and coiled-coil motif-containing protein, is a protein encoded by the GOPC gene in humans. PIST is a Golgi protein that contains a PDZ domain. PDZ domains are structural motifs composed of approximately 90 amino acids, and they are known to bind to the extreme C-terminus of target proteins in a sequence-specific manner. GOPC has been demonstrated to interact with several proteins, including GRID2 (Glutamate Receptor Ionotropic, Delta-2), BECN1 (Beclin-1, a key regulator of autophagy), RHOQ (a member of the Rho family of GTPases), ACCN3 (Acid-Sensing Ion Channel 3), CFTR (Cystic Fibrosis Transmembrane Conductance Regulator, a chloride channel implicated in cystic fibrosis), and CSPG5 (Chondroitin Sulfate Proteoglycan 5, also known as neuroglycan C).
